item.title: Notre Dame Advances to State Final Four With Big Win Over Trinity Christian
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) The Notre Dame girls basketball team is storming into the state Final Four! The Irish beat Trinity Christian 80-54 in the Elite Eight on Friday to advance to their first ever state Final Four. Mimi Lee led the way for Notre Dame with 37 points.
